**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/23 (Tue) 21:32
- [FACT] User asked about the historical event of Germany taking Alsace-Lorraine from France.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Germany took control of the Alsace-Lorraine region from France as a result of the Franco-Prussian War.
- [TEMPORAL] The Franco-Prussian War was fought from July 19, 1870 to May 10, 1871.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Germany was able to force France to sign the Treaty of Frankfurt on May 10, 1871, which officially ended the war.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] As part of the terms of the Treaty of Frankfurt, France ceded control of the Alsace-Lorraine region to Germany.
- [FACT] User communicated in Indonesian, stating "Jerman mengambil wilayah Alsace-Lorraine dari Perancis dalam Perang Perancis."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Confirmed the user's statement in Indonesian, reiterating that Germany took control of Alsace-Lorraine from France as a result of the Franco-Prussian War.
- [TEMPORAL] Reiterated that the Franco-Prussian War lasted from July 19, 1870 to May 10, 1871.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mentioned that after several military victories, Germany forced France to sign the Treaty of Frankfurt on May 10, 1871.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Stated that as part of the treaty, France ceded control of Alsace-Lorraine to Germany.
